title: PILLAGERS AND MACHINES FIGHT ON CONTACT
why: His words on suggestion 23: pillagers and machines should fight each other even without decoys. Before, a pillager who was looting shot a machine he met, and a Sentry or Crawler that could not see you went for a pillager in sight, but a pillager running for the ring, which is where most of them are most of the time, ignored every machine he passed, and a Warden or Bulwark had eyes for nobody but you. Now a pillager heading for the ring stops and shoots a machine that is in sight within 280 units, the way he already does with a rival crew, and a plain Warden or a Bulwark that cannot see you shoots at a pillager in sight. THE OVERSEER keeps to its lair and the Crier, the Peddler and the Survivor stay out of it. No decoy or noise is needed: being in sight of each other is enough, so a firefight you can walk up to and loot afterward turns up on its own.
now: Pillagers heading for the ring now fight machines they meet, and Wardens and Bulwarks fight pillagers they see.
